source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

hinge.title: Decide whether an object is luminous or non-luminous from whether it emits its own light.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: A glowing electric lamp is non-luminous.

intelligence.enrichment: An object that emits its own light is luminous; an object that does not emit its own light is non-luminous, even when it is visible by reflected light. Emitting its own light makes an object a source of light; not emitting its own light and only reflecting light makes it non-luminous. The learner correctly applies this rule: An object that emits its own light is luminous; an object that does not emit its own light is non-luminous, even when it is visible by reflected light. If an object looks bright in the sky or helps us see, it must be luminous.
